about: Collection rule. An article is collected if its headline or its RSS summary contains any of these words. Capital and small letters count the same, and a longer word that contains one counts too (for example 'iPhones'). Kept simple on purpose. Add or remove words here.
display_about: How many collected articles the app shows. All collected articles stay saved; only this many are shown, at most per_source from each source (newest first), with the spy articles counted inside the total.
